label: Necessarily, every cause-capable thing included in a causal chain is included in an entire chain
paraphrase: Necessarily, every cause-capable thing included in a causal chain is included in an entire chain. Necessarily, entire chains have no outside causes of members and are thereby ungrounded in the source sense; any internal head of an entire chain has no cause. This records the qualified membership/closure and head commitment as an open source reading, not a proof that every causal chain is linear or that its collective whole is caused.
